description.value: Hillside Winery has been producing award-winning wines on the Naramata Bench since 1984, making it one of the area's longest-running wineries. The on-site Bistro serves terroir-to-table small plates with locally foraged ingredients in a 65-seat dining room and on two outdoor patios overlooking Okanagan Lake. Located on Naramata Road—a cornerstone of Okanagan cycling—it is a natural refreshment stop for touring cyclists riding the Bench.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hillside Winery & Bistro is an active establishment at 1350 Naramata Road with a wine shop, tasting experiences, and a 65-seat bistro featuring outdoor patios. Phone (250) 493-6274, email info@hillsidewinery.ca, and address all match between OSM and the website footer. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms on the website, so all required criteria are null. The copyright is 2026 and the team page and hours are current, confirming the business is open. OSM name is 'Hillside Winery' while the website consistently uses 'Hillside Winery & Bistro'.
concerns: OSM name is 'Hillside Winery' but the website consistently brands as 'Hillside Winery & Bistro'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established winery with a full-service bistro on Naramata Road, one of BC's premier cycling corridors. Touring cyclists would clearly benefit from this food-and-drink stop, even though bike-specific amenities are not mentioned on the website.
